name: maikelsoft-skills
description: Skills and agents by Maikel. Each skill writes clear output: ASD-STE100 Simplified Technical English, or Begrijpelijk Nederlands (B1).

plugins.name: dev-docs
plugins.description: Write, rewrite, and review developer documentation: README, tutorial, how-to, reference, explanation, ADR, changelog, code comments, and UI text. /update-docs checks and updates the whole doc set of a project.

plugins.name: dev-flow
plugins.description: Builds one work item (story, bug, task, or chore) from its ticket to tested commits, spec first. Copies the Behaviour spec of the ticket and locks one test file for each rule. Builds one scenario at a time with TDD. Proves the result with held-back tests, a mutation check, and fresh reviews. Sets the size from the change and the risk. Product questions go back to the product owner on the ticket.

plugins.name: dev-build
plugins.description: Build good agent skills and agents: research, concept, test, build. Skills build-skill and build-agent, with checkers. Agents for Claude Code, the Agent SDK, Managed Agents, and OpenClaw.

plugins.name: product-flow
plugins.description: One command for each phase of the backlog work: an idea, a request, or a bug to approved items. Each user story and bug gets acceptance criteria and a Gherkin Behaviour spec, a refine pass with the product owner, and a push to Jira, Azure DevOps, GitHub, GitLab, Linear, or files after approval. Research, a story map, and a prototype only for larger work. For product owners and business analysts.

plugins.name: dev-stack
plugins.description: Stack skills for a .NET 10 team with an Angular front end: C#, ASP.NET Core, OpenAPI, validation, EF Core, SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MSTest 4, analyzers, observability, Redis, Elasticsearch, RabbitMQ, Wolverine, MailKit, PuppeteerSharp, Angular, secure coding, and the move to AwesomeAssertions. Version-specific rules, a check step with a tool, and one report format.

plugins.name: dev-team
plugins.description: A small developer team for one work item, when you ask for the team: a senior designs and builds the core, mediors build work packages, a security reviewer checks the diff, and the main session leads with two human gates. Needs dev-stack. Preview.

plugins.name: ux-design
plugins.description: /ux-design designs one item with UI before the build: problem frame, flow, pattern rules, design spec with a source for each decision, states, mockups, and a prototype for a test with users. /ux-review checks the built screens against the design. A UX designer agent does the work. Also Claude Design, Figma, and OpenPencil, brand files and DTCG tokens, and WCAG 2.2 accessibility.

plugins.name: dev-setup
plugins.description: One setup for the delivery flow: your role for all projects or one repository, the facts of the project, REVIEW.md, a pull request template, a CI check, and the Claude Code basics of a project.
